title: Murder
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office engages in a murder mystery game while dealing with rumors of bankruptcy and a concerning email from corporate about payments. The episode features humorous role-playing, character interactions, and unresolved questions about the murder case and corporate financial issues.
